projectState.summary: The repo has a Studio Pattern scaffold, GitHub setup notes, and an initial plan for a browser-first local Ollama-powered musical terrarium. Claude's first review was ingested. Current first implementation slice is a rule-based PixiJS/Tone.js terrarium with three musical players. Grow is solo for now, but future architecture may allow multiple terrariums/bands that can observe or react to each other.
